name: kolmogorov_forward_chain_classical
divergence_log: Kolmogorov forward equation on a discrete chain propagates classical populations p_i(t) through a commuting transition kernel. It has a real spectrum bounded above by zero; quantum walks on the same graph have a unitary propagator with ballistic (not diffusive) spreading and spectrum on the unit circle. The nonclassical analog is a Lindbladian whose dissipative part reduces to Q on populations but acts nontrivially on coherences.
